<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>At the classroom desk</title>
<style>
html,body{width:240px;height:242px;margin:0;overflow:hidden;background:#a79c8f}
canvas{display:block;width:240px;height:242px}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { RoundedBoxGeometry } from 'three/addons/geometries/RoundedBoxGeometry.js';

const W = 240, H = 242;
const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ preserveDrawingBuffer: true });
renderer.setPixelRatio(1);
renderer.setSize(W, H, false);
renderer.outputColorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;
renderer.shadowMap.type = THREE.PCFShadowMap;
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

const scene = new THREE.Scene();
scene.background = new THREE.Color(0xa89c89);
const angle = THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(25);
const si = Math.sin(angle), co = Math.cos(angle);
const view = new THREE.Vector3(0, si, co);
const screenUp = new THREE.Vector3(0, co, -si);
const screenBasis = new THREE.Matrix4().makeBasis(
  new THREE.Vector3(1, 0, 0), screenUp, view
);
const ref = new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-120, 120, 121, -121, 1, 1650);
ref.position.copy(view).multiplyScalar(690);
ref.lookAt(0, 0, 0);
ref.updateMatrixWorld();

function delta(x, y, depth) {
  return new THREE.Vector3(x, -co*y + si*depth, si*y + co*depth);
}
function point(x, y, depth) {
  return delta(x - 120, y - 121, depth);
}

const tableHeight = -91;
function onTable(x, y, height = 0) {
  const wy = tableHeight + height;
  return new THREE.Vector3(x - 120, wy, (co * wy - (121 - y)) / si);
}

const origin = new THREE.Vector3();
function group(name, parent, pivot) {
  const g = new THREE.Group();
  g.name = name;
  parent.add(g);
  if (pivot) g.position.copy(parent.worldToLocal(pivot.clone()));
  return g;
}

function standard(color, roughness = 0.85, extra = {}) {
  return new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color, roughness, ...extra });
}

function mesh(parent, name, geo, material, position, cast = true, receive = true) {
  const m = new THREE.Mesh(geo, material);
  m.name = name;
  parent.add(m);
  if (position) m.position.copy(parent.worldToLocal(position.clone()));
  m.castShadow = cast;
  m.receiveShadow = receive;
  return m;
}

const unitSphere = new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 40, 26);
function oval(parent, name, center, dimensions, mat, twist = 0) {
  const m = mesh(parent, name, unitSphere, mat, center);
  m.quaternion.setFromRotationMatrix(screenBasis);
  m.rotateZ(twist);
  m.scale.set(...dimensions);
  return m;
}

function box(parent, name, size, at, mat, radius = 0, cast = true) {
  const geo = radius ? new RoundedBoxGeometry(...size, 3, radius)
    : new THREE.BoxGeometry(...size);
  return mesh(parent, name, geo, mat, new THREE.Vector3(...at), cast);
}

function colorCode(hex) {
  const c = new THREE.Color(hex);
  return `vec3(${c.r.toFixed(6)},${c.g.toFixed(6)},${c.b.toFixed(6)})`;
}

const noiseGLSL = `
float nwbHash(vec3 p){
  p = fract(p * 0.1031);
  p += dot(p, p.yzx + 33.33);
  return fract((p.x + p.y) * p.z);
}
float nwbNoise(vec3 p){
  vec3 i = floor(p);
  vec3 f = fract(p);
  f = f*f*(3.0-2.0*f);
  return mix(
    mix(mix(nwbHash(i),nwbHash(i+vec3(1,0,0)),f.x),
        mix(nwbHash(i+vec3(0,1,0)),nwbHash(i+vec3(1,1,0)),f.x),f.y),
    mix(mix(nwbHash(i+vec3(0,0,1)),nwbHash(i+vec3(1,0,1)),f.x),
        mix(nwbHash(i+vec3(0,1,1)),nwbHash(i+vec3(1,1,1)),f.x),f.y),f.z);
}
`;

function surfaceMaterial(color, mode) {
  const mat = standard(color, mode === 'wood' ? 0.73 : 0.94);
  const body = mode === 'left-belly' || mode === 'right-belly';
  const left = mode === 'left-belly';
  const patch = !body ? '' : `
    vec2 belly = vec2(nwbP.x - (${left ? '-60.0' : '83.0'}),
      ${co.toFixed(7)}*nwbP.y-${si.toFixed(7)}*nwbP.z+56.0);
    belly.x += belly.y * ${left ? '0.08' : '-0.19'};
    float edge = length(belly / vec2(${left ? '43.0,36.0' : '39.0,38.0'}));
    edge += 0.012*(nwbNoise(nwbP*0.57)*2.0-1.0);
    float cream = (1.0-smoothstep(0.938,1.029,edge))
      *smoothstep(${left ? '-71.0,-53.0' : '-77.0,-56.0'},nwbP.z);
    diffuseColor.rgb = mix(diffuseColor.rgb,
      ${colorCode(left ? 0xe8c99b : 0xefc894)},cream);
  `;
  const variation = mode === 'wood' ? `
    float warp = nwbNoise(nwbP*vec3(0.024,0.011,0.040))*3.6;
    float grain = nwbNoise(vec3(nwbP.x*0.026,nwbP.y*0.032,nwbP.z*0.36+warp));
    float pores = nwbNoise(vec3(nwbP.x*0.11,nwbP.y*0.05,nwbP.z*1.2+warp));
    diffuseColor.rgb *= 0.88+0.20*grain+0.12*pores;
  ` : `
    float nap = nwbNoise(nwbP*0.99);
    float flecks = nwbNoise(nwbP*2.28+vec3(6.4,0,2.1));
    float mottling = nwbNoise(nwbP*0.117);
    diffuseColor.rgb *= 0.905 + 0.097*nap + 0.058*flecks + 0.057*mottling;
  `;
  mat.customProgramCacheKey = () => `classroom-surface-${mode}`;
  mat.onBeforeCompile = shader => {
    shader.vertexShader = 'varying vec3 nwbP;\n'
      + (body ? 'attribute vec3 restPosition;\n' : '') + shader.vertexShader;
    shader.vertexShader = shader.vertexShader.replace(
      '#include <begin_vertex>', `#include <begin_vertex>\nnwbP = ${body ? 'restPosition' : 'position'};`
    );
    shader.fragmentShader = 'varying vec3 nwbP;\n' + noiseGLSL + shader.fragmentShader;
    shader.fragmentShader = shader.fragmentShader.replace(
      '#include <color_fragment>', '#include <color_fragment>\n' + patch + variation
    );
  };
  return mat;
}

const lighting = group('classroom-lighting', scene);
lighting.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xfff5e9, 0xb69a80, 1.55));
function directional(name, color, intensity, position) {
  const light = new THREE.DirectionalLight(color, intensity);
  light.name = name;
  light.position.set(...position);
  light.target.position.set(0, -43, -38);
  lighting.add(light, light.target);
  return light;
}
const key = directional('soft upper left light', 0xffeed7, 2.18, [-170, 240, 185]);
key.castShadow = true;
key.shadow.mapSize.set(1024, 1024);
Object.assign(key.shadow.camera, {
  left: -165, right: 165, top: 158, bottom: -162, near: 15, far: 590
});
key.shadow.camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
key.shadow.normalBias = 0.85;
key.shadow.bias = -0.00025;
key.shadow.radius = 2.8;
directional('window spill', 0xffedcc, 1.10, [124, 153, -155]);
directional('front bounce', 0xe6ebff, 0.39, [162, 18, 225]);
directional('rear ambient bounce', 0xe4eeff, 0.32, [-124, 40, -223]);

const background = group('classroom-background', scene);
const wallMat = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
  vertexShader: `
    varying vec3 roomPosition;
    void main(){
      roomPosition = (modelMatrix * vec4(position,1.0)).xyz;
      gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position,1.0);
    }
  `,
  fragmentShader: `
    varying vec3 roomPosition;
    ${noiseGLSL}
    void main(){
      vec2 p = vec2(roomPosition.x+120.0,
        121.0-(${co.toFixed(7)}*roomPosition.y-${si.toFixed(7)}*roomPosition.z));
      float grain = nwbNoise(vec3(p*0.73,3.0));
      float broad = nwbNoise(vec3(p*0.049,8.0));
      vec3 color = mix(${colorCode(0xb8a99a)},${colorCode(0xa5a8ab)},
        smoothstep(12.0,223.0,p.x)*0.96);
      color *= 0.96+0.072*broad+0.035*grain;
      float edge = 36.7-0.028*(p.x-72.0);
      float shadow = smoothstep(59.0,75.0,p.x)*(1.0-smoothstep(edge,edge+6.0,p.y));
      color *= 1.0-0.29*shadow;
      float frame = smoothstep(66.0,75.5,p.x)*(1.0-smoothstep(edge-2.0,edge+2.8,p.y));
      color = mix(color,${colorCode(0x615245)}*(0.94+0.10*broad),frame);
      float board = smoothstep(72.0,80.0,p.x)*(1.0-smoothstep(edge-8.3,edge-3.8,p.y));
      vec3 chalk = mix(${colorCode(0x12282e)},${colorCode(0x203d42)},
        smoothstep(60.0,248.0,p.x)*0.87);
      chalk *= 0.87+0.21*broad+0.05*grain;
      color = mix(color,chalk,board);
      float eraser = exp(-pow(abs(p.x-114.0)/17.0,2.0)-pow(abs(p.y-31.3)/2.3,2.0));
      color = mix(color,${colorCode(0x8c7961)},eraser*0.71);
      float rail = smoothstep(77.0,85.0,p.y)*(1.0-smoothstep(89.0,101.0,p.y));
      color = mix(color,${colorCode(0x8d745b)},rail*(0.65+0.12*broad));
      gl_FragColor = vec4(color,1.0);
      #include <colorspace_fragment>
    }
  `
});
mesh(background, 'plaster wall and chalkboard', new THREE.PlaneGeometry(930, 510),
  wallMat, new THREE.Vector3(0, 62, -244), false, false);
const rearWood = standard(0x896347);
const rearEdge = standard(0x5e432e);
const rearTop = standard(0x9e7551);
box(background, 'wall-side worktop', [309, 5.5, 23], [3, -46, -187], rearTop, 2, false);
box(background, 'worktop edge', [310, 6, 5], [3, -49, -174], rearEdge, 1.8, false);
box(background, 'left rear table', [67, 9, 31], [-123, -53, -153], rearWood, 3, false);
box(background, 'right rear table', [142, 7.5, 41], [150, -65, -151], rearTop, 2.4, false);
box(background, 'right apron', [141, 13, 5], [150, -71, -131], rearEdge, 1.7, false);
box(background, 'right table leg', [6, 51, 7], [107, -100, -137], rearWood, 1, false);
box(background, 'chair back', [9, 20, 8], [115, -50, -195], rearEdge, 3.1, false);
const floor = mesh(background, 'floor', new THREE.PlaneGeometry(980, 880),
  standard(0x89715a), new THREE.Vector3(0, -127, -18), false);
floor.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;

const desk = group('shared-wooden-desk', scene);
const desktop = mesh(desk, 'honey-colored desktop', new THREE.PlaneGeometry(369, 160),
  surfaceMaterial(0xba7b3c, 'wood'), new THREE.Vector3(0, tableHeight, 34), false);
desktop.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
box(desk, 'solid desktop edge', [369, 5, 160], [0, tableHeight - 2.58, 34],
  standard(0xa86a32), 1.35, false);
box(desk, 'desk apron', [338, 11, 6], [0, -100, 108], standard(0x80502c), 0.75, false);
box(desk, 'left desk leg', [9, 32, 10], [-151, -111, 98], rearWood, 1, false);
box(desk, 'right desk leg', [9, 32, 10], [151, -111, 98], rearWood, 1, false);

function radialTexture() {
  const size = 32, pixels = new Uint8Array(size * size * 4);
  for (let y = 0; y < size; y++) {
    for (let x = 0; x < size; x++) {
      const r = Math.hypot((x+0.5-size/2)/(size/2), (y+0.5-size/2)/(size/2));
      const alpha = Math.max(0, 1 - r*r);
      pixels.set([56, 34, 20, Math.round(255 * alpha ** 3)], (x + y * size) * 4);
    }
  }
  const map = new THREE.DataTexture(pixels, size, size);
  map.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
  map.magFilter = THREE.LinearFilter;
  map.minFilter = THREE.LinearFilter;
  map.needsUpdate = true;
  return map;
}
const shadowTexture = radialTexture();
function contactShadow(name, x, y, width, length, opacity) {
  const mat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
    map: shadowTexture, transparent: true, depthWrite: false, opacity
  });
  const shadow = mesh(desk, name, new THREE.PlaneGeometry(width, length), mat,
    onTable(x, y, 0.055), false, false);
  shadow.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
  return shadow;
}
contactShadow('left book contact shadow', 84, 220, 180, 58, 0.52);
contactShadow('right book contact shadow', 210, 205, 131, 59, 0.41);
const writingShadow = contactShadow('writing hand contact shadow', 36, 212, 42, 29, 0.32);
contactShadow('resting fingers contact shadow', 109, 204, 41, 29, 0.27);

function geometry(vertices, indices) {
  const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  g.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(vertices, 3));
  g.setIndex(indices);
  g.computeVertexNormals();
  return g;
}

function gridGeometry(fn, nu, nv, reverse) {
  const vertices = [], indices = [];
  for (let j = 0; j <= nv; j++) {
    for (let i = 0; i <= nu; i++) vertices.push(...fn(i / nu, j / nv).toArray());
  }
  for (let j = 0; j < nv; j++) {
    for (let i = 0; i < nu; i++) {
      const a = j * (nu+1) + i, b = a+1, c = a+nu+1, d = c+1;
      indices.push(...(reverse ? [a,c,b,b,c,d] : [a,b,c,b,d,c]));
    }
  }
  return geometry(vertices, indices);
}

const paperMaterial = color => standard(color, 0.93, { side: THREE.DoubleSide });
const ivoryPaper = paperMaterial(0xf4e7ce);
const palePaper = paperMaterial(0xf1e6d3);
const pageEdges = [0xa69174, 0xd7c5a7, 0xb4a184, 0xe1d1b7].map(paperMaterial);
const bookCover = paperMaterial(0x80633e);
const bindingMat = paperMaterial(0xa18b6d);

function openBook(name, spine, leftEdge, rightEdge, bend, paper) {
  const book = group(name, desk, onTable(...spine[1]));
  const corners = pair => pair.map(q => onTable(...q));
  const hinge = corners(spine);
  for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
    const edge = corners(side < 0 ? leftEdge : rightEdge);
    const leaf = group(side < 0 ? 'left-page-block' : 'right-page-block', book, hinge[0]);
    function page(u, v, layer = 0, spread = 0) {
      const inner = hinge[0].clone().lerp(hinge[1], v);
      const outer = edge[0].clone().lerp(edge[1], v);
      const p = inner.lerp(outer, u * (1 + spread));
      const curl = Math.sin(Math.PI * u) ** 1.15;
      const swell = 0.82 + 0.34 * Math.cos(Math.PI * (v - 0.18));
      p.y += 2.9 + curl * bend[side < 0 ? 0 : 1] * swell
        + u * (0.53 + 0.30 * Math.cos(Math.PI * v)) + layer;
      p.z -= 1.35 * curl * (1 - v);
      return p;
    }
    mesh(leaf, 'underlying cover', gridGeometry((u, v) => page(u, v, -2.36, 0.032),
      20, 12, side > 0), bookCover, origin, false);
    for (const coords of [st => [st, 1], st => [1, st], st => [st, 0]]) {
      for (let i = 0; i < pageEdges.length; i++) {
        const lower = -2.32 + i * 0.58;
        const band = gridGeometry((st, h) => {
          const [u, v] = coords(st);
          return page(u, v, lower + h * 0.58, (1 - (i+h)/4) * 0.027);
        }, 22, 1, false);
        mesh(leaf, 'layered paper edge', band, pageEdges[i], origin, false);
      }
    }
    mesh(leaf, 'curved top sheet', gridGeometry((u, v) => page(u, v), 35, 19, side > 0),
      paper, origin, false);
    if (side > 0) {
      mesh(leaf, 'binding crease', gridGeometry((u,v) => page(u*0.018,v,0.036),
        2, 24, true), bindingMat, origin, false);
    }
  }
}
openBook('open writing notebook', [[59,206],[94,232]], [[3,221],[22,238]],
  [[113,205],[168,227]], [3.1,6.8], ivoryPaper);
openBook('open notebook on the right', [[217,192],[241,216]], [[158,203],[196,224]],
  [[273,191],[293,212]], [2.8,3.3], palePaper);

const up = new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0);
function rod(parent, name, a, b, ra, rb, mat, cast = true) {
  const axis = b.clone().sub(a);
  const m = mesh(parent, name, new THREE.CylinderGeometry(rb, ra, axis.length(), 16),
    mat, a.clone().add(b).multiplyScalar(0.5), cast);
  m.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(up, axis.normalize());
  return m;
}

const graphite = standard(0x2b2925, 0.71);
const pencilWood = standard(0xddb578, 0.84);
function deskPencil(name, start, end, color, radius) {
  const a = onTable(...start, radius + 0.14);
  const b = onTable(...end, radius + 0.14);
  const pencil = group(name, desk, a);
  const shoulder = a.clone().lerp(b, 0.87);
  const lead = a.clone().lerp(b, 0.961);
  rod(pencil, 'lacquered shaft', a, shoulder, radius, radius, standard(color), false);
  rod(pencil, 'exposed cedar', shoulder, lead, radius, radius*0.34, pencilWood, false);
  rod(pencil, 'graphite tip', lead, b, radius*0.34, 0.05, graphite, false);
}
deskPencil('ochre pencil', [177,214], [225,229], 0x9e6130, 1.35);
deskPencil('short brown pencil', [204,224], [232,232], 0x663e27, 1.12);
deskPencil('pencil at the lower left', [-7,226], [21,243], 0x494036, 1.83);
deskPencil('pencil beside the left edge', [-11,233], [10,246], 0xbb8d59, 1.35);
const rightPen = group('dark pen beside the right notebook', desk);
rod(rightPen, 'pen barrel', onTable(230,221.5,1.7), onTable(250,216,1.7),
  1.7, 1.9, standard(0x312a24), false);
rod(rightPen, 'pen trim', onTable(229,221.8,1.7), onTable(232,221.1,1.7),
  1.5, 1.7, standard(0xa9a38c), false);

const leftSkin = surfaceMaterial(0xe9ac30, 'left-belly');
const rightSkin = surfaceMaterial(0xecae31, 'right-belly');
const leftLimb = surfaceMaterial(0xe7a52c, 'fleece');
const rightLimb = surfaceMaterial(0xecad2d, 'fleece');
const handMat = surfaceMaterial(0x655b4c, 'fleece');
const fingerMat = surfaceMaterial(0x706455, 'fleece');
const farHandMat = surfaceMaterial(0x554736, 'fleece');

function hermite(a, b, slopeA, slopeB, t) {
  const tt = t*t, ttt = tt*t;
  return (2*ttt-3*tt+1)*a + (ttt-2*tt+t)*slopeA
    + (-2*ttt+3*tt)*b + (ttt-tt)*slopeB;
}

function smooth(a, b, value) {
  const n = THREE.MathUtils.clamp((value-a)/(b-a), 0, 1);
  return n*n*(3-2*n);
}

function sculptBody(character, controls, neck, skin, isLeft) {
  const bands = 64, ringsPerStep = 5;
  const vertices = [], indices = [];
  for (let seg = 0; seg < controls.length-1; seg++) {
    const a = controls[seg], b = controls[seg+1];
    const back = controls[Math.max(0,seg-1)];
    const next = controls[Math.min(controls.length-1,seg+2)];
    const distance = b[0]-a[0];
    const last = seg === controls.length-2 ? ringsPerStep : ringsPerStep-1;
    for (let r = 0; r <= last; r++) {
      const t = r / ringsPerStep;
      const fields = [];
      for (let k = 1; k <= 4; k++) {
        fields.push(hermite(a[k],b[k],
          (b[k]-back[k])*distance/(b[0]-back[0]),
          (next[k]-a[k])*distance/(next[0]-a[0]),t));
      }
      const [x,z,rx,rz] = fields;
      const y = a[0]+distance*t;
      for (let k = 0; k < bands; k++) {
        const phase = 2*Math.PI*k/bands;
        vertices.push(x-120+Math.sin(phase)*Math.max(0,rx),
          y,z+Math.cos(phase)*Math.max(0,rz));
      }
    }
  }
  const count = vertices.length/(bands*3);
  for (let r = 0; r < count-1; r++) {
    for (let k = 0; k < bands; k++) {
      const a = r*bands+k, b = r*bands+(k+1)%bands;
      indices.push(a,b,a+bands,b,b+bands,a+bands);
    }
  }
  const all = geometry(vertices, indices);
  const positions = all.attributes.position.array;
  const normals = all.attributes.normal.array;
  const rest = positions.slice();
  const cut = neck*ringsPerStep;
  const joint = controls[neck];
  const torso = group('torso', character);
  const head = group('head', character, new THREE.Vector3(joint[1]-120,joint[0],joint[2]));
  function piece(first, after) {
    const start = first*bands, end = (after+1)*bands;
    const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
    g.setAttribute('position', new THREE.BufferAttribute(positions.subarray(start*3,end*3),3)
      .setUsage(THREE.DynamicDrawUsage));
    g.setAttribute('normal', new THREE.BufferAttribute(normals.subarray(start*3,end*3),3)
      .setUsage(THREE.DynamicDrawUsage));
    g.setAttribute('restPosition', new THREE.BufferAttribute(rest.subarray(start*3,end*3),3));
    g.setIndex(indices.slice(first*bands*6,after*bands*6).map(i => i-start));
    g.computeBoundingSphere();
    g.boundingSphere.radius += 38;
    return g;
  }
  const surfaces = [
    mesh(torso, 'soft torso and belly', piece(0,cut), skin, origin),
    mesh(head, 'soft rounded head', piece(cut,count-1), skin, origin)
  ];
  const pivotX = (isLeft ? 55 : 150)-120;
  const pivotY = 121-(isLeft ? 89 : 82);
  const pivotDepth = isLeft ? -72 : -77;
  const profile = new Float32Array(rest.length);
  const weight = new Float32Array(rest.length/3);
  const belly = new Float32Array(weight.length);
  for (let i = 0; i < rest.length; i += 3) {
    const x = rest[i], y = rest[i+1], z = rest[i+2];
    profile[i] = x;
    profile[i+1] = co*y-si*z;
    profile[i+2] = si*y+co*z;
    const sy = 121-profile[i+1];
    weight[i/3] = 1-smooth(isLeft ? 105 : 102,isLeft ? 153 : 145,sy);
    belly[i/3] = Math.exp(-(((sy-142)/35)**2))*(1-smooth(176,222,sy));
  }
  const rotation = new THREE.Quaternion();
  const pitchEuler = new THREE.Euler(0,0,0,'ZYX');
  const p = new THREE.Vector3();
  function pose([shift, lift, yaw, pitch, roll, rise]) {
    rotation.setFromEuler(pitchEuler.set(pitch,yaw,roll,'ZYX'));
    for (let i = 0; i < positions.length; i += 3) {
      const x = profile[i], y = profile[i+1], d = profile[i+2];
      const w = weight[i/3], b = belly[i/3] * rise;
      p.set(x-pivotX,y-pivotY,d-pivotDepth).applyQuaternion(rotation);
      const sx = x + w*(p.x+pivotX-x+shift) + (1-w)*b*
        (isLeft ? -0.28+0.009*(x+61) : -0.22);
      const sy = y + w*(p.y+pivotY-y+lift) + (1-w)*b;
      const depth = d + w*(p.z+pivotDepth-d) + (1-w)*b*0.11;
      positions[i] = sx;
      positions[i+1] = co*sy+si*depth;
      positions[i+2] = -si*sy+co*depth;
    }
    // Both pieces share the normals of the continuous surface at the neck.
    all.computeVertexNormals();
    for (const surface of surfaces) {
      surface.geometry.attributes.position.needsUpdate = true;
      surface.geometry.attributes.normal.needsUpdate = true;
    }
  }
  return { head, surfaces, pose };
}

const raycaster = new THREE.Raycaster();
const ndc = new THREE.Vector2();
function pickSurface(body, x, y) {
  for (const shift of [0,1,-1,2.5,-2.5,4,-4,6,-6,9,-9]) {
    ndc.set((x+shift)/120-1,1-y/121);
    raycaster.setFromCamera(ndc, ref);
    const hit = raycaster.intersectObjects(body.surfaces,false)[0];
    if (hit) {
      const normal = (hit.normal || hit.face.normal).clone().transformDirection(hit.object.matrixWorld);
      return { point: hit.point, normal, depth: hit.point.dot(view) };
    }
  }
  return { point: point(x,y,-51), normal: view.clone(), depth: -51 };
}

function makeEye(body, parent, name, rx, ry, dx, dy, turn, bias) {
  const g = group(name,parent);
  eyePiece(g,'recess around eye',[0,0,-1.36],[rx+0.86,ry+0.7,2.65],eyeSocket);
  eyePiece(g,'charcoal eye dome',[0,0,-0.03],[rx,ry,rx*0.5+0.38],eyeOuter);
  const gaze = group('pupil and iris',g);
  eyePiece(gaze,'iris',[0,0,0.05],[rx*0.68,ry*0.71,rx*0.25],iris);
  eyePiece(gaze,'pupil',[0.20,-0.24,rx*0.166],[rx*0.48,ry*0.55,rx*0.13],pupil);
  eyePiece(gaze,'soft catchlight',[-rx*0.244,ry*0.265,rx*0.275],
    [rx*0.141,ry*0.12,0.48],catchlight);
  const basis = new THREE.Matrix4();
  const across = new THREE.Vector3();
  const upright = new THREE.Vector3();
  return (x,y,width,lookX,lookY) => {
    const hit = pickSurface(body,x,y);
    const forward = hit.normal.lerp(view,bias).normalize();
    across.crossVectors(screenUp,forward).normalize();
    upright.crossVectors(forward,across).normalize();
    g.position.copy(parent.worldToLocal(hit.point.addScaledVector(view,0.85)));
    g.quaternion.setFromRotationMatrix(basis.makeBasis(across,upright,forward));
    g.rotateZ(turn);
    g.scale.set(width,1,1);
    gaze.position.set(dx+lookX,dy+lookY,rx*0.36);
    gaze.rotation.set(-(dy+lookY)*0.075,(dx+lookX)*0.10,0);
  };
}

function makeMouth(body, knots, color, openColor, lipColor) {
  const g = group('mouth',body.head);
  const track = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(knots.map(k => new THREE.Vector3(...k)),false,'catmullrom');
  const center = track.getPoint(0.5);
  const columns = 24;
  const closedShade = new THREE.Color(color), openShade = new THREE.Color(openColor);
  const mouthMat = standard(color,0.97,{side:THREE.DoubleSide});
  const lipMat = standard(lipColor,0.96,{side:THREE.DoubleSide});
  function strip(name, material) {
    const indices = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < columns; i++) {
      const a = i*2;
      indices.push(a,a+2,a+1,a+2,a+3,a+1);
    }
    const geom = geometry(new Float32Array((columns+1)*6),indices);
    geom.attributes.position.setUsage(THREE.DynamicDrawUsage);
    const object = mesh(g,name,geom,material,origin,false,false);
    object.frustumCulled = false;
    return geom;
  }
  const lip = strip('lower lip',lipMat);
  const opening = strip('mouth opening',mouthMat);
  const base = Array.from({length:columns+1},(_,i) => track.getPoint(i/columns));
  function put(geom,i,row,x,y,depth) {
    geom.attributes.position.setXYZ(i*2+row,x-120,co*(121-y)+si*depth,-si*(121-y)+co*depth);
  }
  return ([dx,dy,width,amount,slope]) => {
    mouthMat.color.copy(closedShade).lerp(openShade,amount);
    for (let i = 0; i <= columns; i++) {
      const s = 2*i/columns-1;
      const k = base[i];
      const x = center.x+dx+(k.x-center.x)*width;
      const middle = THREE.MathUtils.lerp((k.y+k.z)*0.5, (center.y+center.z)*0.5+s*slope, amount)+dy;
      const thick = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(
        Math.max(0.16,k.z-k.y),0.18+3.8*Math.pow(Math.max(0,1-s*s),0.85),amount);
      const top = middle-thick*0.5;
      const bottom = middle+thick*0.5;
      const hit = pickSurface(body,x,middle);
      const depthSlope = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(hit.normal.dot(screenUp)/
        Math.max(0.18,hit.normal.dot(view)),-1.6,1.6);
      const depthAt = (y,lift) => hit.depth+(y-middle)*depthSlope+lift;
      put(opening,i,0,x,top,depthAt(top,0.76));
      put(opening,i,1,x,bottom,depthAt(bottom,0.76));
      const lipTop = bottom-0.17;
      const lipBottom = lipTop+0.35+thick*0.34;
      put(lip,i,0,x,lipTop,depthAt(lipTop,0.37));
      put(lip,i,1,x,lipBottom,depthAt(lipBottom,0.37));
    }
    for (const geom of [lip,opening]) {
      geom.attributes.position.needsUpdate = true;
      geom.computeVertexNormals();
    }
  };
}

function sweep(parent, name, path, mat, ellipticity = 0.90, flexible = false) {
  const points = path.map(p => point(p[0],p[1],p[2]));
  const curve = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(points,false,'catmullrom',0.5);
  const sides = 26, lengthSteps = Math.max(21,(path.length-1)*10);
  const vertices = [], faces = [], along = [];
  function radius(t) {
    const pos = t*(path.length-1);
    const i = Math.min(path.length-2,Math.floor(pos));
    const a = path[i][3], b = path[i+1][3];
    const before = path[Math.max(0,i-1)][3];
    const after = path[Math.min(path.length-1,i+2)][3];
    return Math.max(0.025,hermite(a,b,0.5*(b-before),0.5*(after-a),pos-i));
  }
  for (let j = 0; j <= lengthSteps; j++) {
    const t = j/lengthSteps;
    const at = curve.getPoint(t);
    const tangent = curve.getTangent(t);
    const across = new THREE.Vector3().crossVectors(tangent,view);
    if (across.lengthSq() < 0.00001) across.crossVectors(tangent,screenUp);
    across.normalize();
    const other = new THREE.Vector3().crossVectors(tangent,across);
    const r = radius(t);
    for (let i = 0; i < sides; i++) {
      const a = i*2*Math.PI/sides;
      const p = at.clone().addScaledVector(across,r*Math.cos(a))
        .addScaledVector(other,r*ellipticity*Math.sin(a));
      vertices.push(p.x,p.y,p.z);
      along.push(t);
    }
  }
  for (let j = 0; j < lengthSteps; j++) {
    for (let i = 0; i < sides; i++) {
      const a = j*sides+i, b = j*sides+(i+1)%sides;
      faces.push(a,b,a+sides,b,b+sides,a+sides);
    }
  }
  const tip = vertices.length/3;
  vertices.push(...points[0].toArray(),...points.at(-1).toArray());
  along.push(0,1);
  for (let i = 0; i < sides; i++) {
    const k = (i+1)%sides, end = lengthSteps*sides;
    faces.push(tip,k,i,tip+1,end+i,end+k);
  }
  const geom = geometry(vertices,faces);
  const object = mesh(parent,name,geom,mat,origin);
  if (flexible) {
    geom.attributes.position.setUsage(THREE.DynamicDrawUsage);
    geom.attributes.normal.setUsage(THREE.DynamicDrawUsage);
    geom.computeBoundingSphere();
    geom.boundingSphere.radius += 36;
    object.userData.bend = (start, end, power) => {
      const array = geom.attributes.position.array;
      for (let i = 0; i < along.length; i++) {
        const t = along[i] ** power;
        const a = 1-t, j = i*3;
        array[j]   = vertices[j]   + start.x*a+end.x*t;
        array[j+1] = vertices[j+1] + start.y*a+end.y*t;
        array[j+2] = vertices[j+2] + start.z*a+end.z*t;
      }
      geom.attributes.position.needsUpdate = true;
      geom.computeVertexNormals();
    };
  }
  return object;
}

const nearHandTrack = [
  [0,0,0,0],[-8.2,-3.7,4.0,-0.07],[-17.1,4.0,8.0,-0.09],
  [-12.7,-0.7,6.4,-0.11],[-15.8,-1.0,7.5,-0.10],
  [-18.3,3.5,8.9,-0.12],[-13.3,-2.3,7.2,-0.08],[-16.2,0.0,8.1,-0.10]
];
const farHandTrack = [
  [0,0,0,0],[-4.1,-2.2,0.5,0.04],[-6.3,-5.2,1,0.07],
  [-9.7,-8.4,0.1,0.13],[-13.4,-9.1,0.5,0.16],
  [-16.7,-10.0,0.3,0.18],[-15.9,-9.6,0.5,0.14],[-16.0,-9.5,0.5,0.14]
];
const restHandTrack = [
  [0,0,0,0],[-0.7,-0.4,-0.2,0.02],[-1.5,-0.1,-0.6,0.03],
  [-1.5,-1.8,-1.0,0.03],[-2.1,-1.9,-1.4,0.04],
  [-2.4,-1.4,-1.4,0.04],[-2.2,-1.7,-1.5,0.04],[-2.3,-1.6,-1.5,0.04]
];
const times = [0,200,400,600,800,1000,1200,1400,1500];
function getPose(time) {
  const i = Math.min(7,Math.floor(time/200));
  const span = times[i+1]-times[i];
  const beforeSpan = i === 0 ? 100 : times[i]-times[i-1];
  const afterSpan = i === 7 ? 200 : times[i+2]-times[i+1];
  const t = (time-times[i])/span;
  const slope = (a,b) => a*b > 0 ? 2*a*b/(a+b) : 0;
  return track => track[i].map((a,k) => {
    const b = track[(i+1)%8][k];
    const before = track[(i+7)%8][k];
    const after = track[(i+2)%8][k];
    const middle = (b-a)/span;
    const from = slope((a-before)/beforeSpan,middle)*span;
    const to = slope(middle,(after-b)/afterSpan)*span;
    return hermite(a,b,from,to,t);
  });
}

const writingRest = writingHand.position.clone();
const shoulderRest = shoulderHand.position.clone();
const embraceRest = embraceHand.position.clone();
const tuckedRest = tuckedHand.position.clone();
function poseHand(hand, rest, [x,y,d,turn]) {
  const movement = delta(x,y,d);
  hand.position.copy(rest).add(movement);
  hand.quaternion.setFromAxisAngle(view,turn);
  return movement;
}

const characters = [left,right];
const sampleTarget = new THREE.WebGLRenderTarget(W*2,H*2,{
  minFilter:THREE.LinearFilter,magFilter:THREE.LinearFilter,depthBuffer:true
});
const displayScene = new THREE.Scene();
const displayCamera = new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-1,1,1,-1,0.1,3);
displayCamera.position.z = 1;
displayScene.add(new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(2,2),new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
  map:sampleTarget.texture,depthTest:false,depthWrite:false,toneMapped:false
})));

function render(t) {
  const at = getPose(((t%1500)+1500)%1500);
  const lp = at(leftPosture), rp = at(rightPosture);
  leftBody.pose(lp);
  rightBody.pose(rp);

  const pen = at(penTrack);
  writerSleeve.userData.bend(delta(lp[0]*0.25,-lp[5]*0.25,0),
    poseHand(writingHand,writingRest,pen),1.55);
  writingShadow.position.copy(onTable(36+pen[0],212+pen[1]*0.66,0.055));
  writingShadow.material.opacity = 0.32+0.009*pen[1];
  tuckedSleeve.userData.bend(delta(lp[0]*0.42,-lp[5]*0.42,0),
    poseHand(tuckedHand,tuckedRest,at(restHandTrack)),1.05);
  shoulderSleeve.userData.bend(delta(rp[0]*0.57,-rp[1]*0.68,0),
    poseHand(shoulderHand,shoulderRest,at(farHandTrack)),1.13);
  embraceSleeve.userData.bend(delta(rp[0]*0.54,-rp[1]*0.55,0),
    poseHand(embraceHand,embraceRest,at(nearHandTrack)),2.1);

  const [lx,ly,lfx,lfy,lfw,gx,gy] = at(leftEyeTrack);
  poseLeftNear(lx,ly,1,gx,gy);
  poseLeftFar(lfx,lfy,lfw,gx*0.55,gy*0.9);
  const [rx,ry,rfx,rfy,rfw,rg] = at(rightEyeTrack);
  poseRightNear(rx,ry,1,0,rg);
  poseRightFar(rfx,rfy,rfw,0,rg);
  poseLeftMouth(at(leftMouthTrack));
  poseRightMouth(at(rightMouthTrack));

  renderer.setRenderTarget(sampleTarget);
  renderer.render(scene,ref);
  renderer.setRenderTarget(null);
  renderer.render(displayScene,displayCamera);
}

render(0);
window.nwb = { scene, renderer, cameras: { ref }, characters, render, ready: true };
</script>
